ons_monthly_jump.title: Unusual change in monthly public finances (ONS)
ons_monthly_jump.text: Spending, receipts or borrowing in this month differs from the same month a year earlier far more than that series' normal movement. Policy changes, one-off payments (such as energy support) and timing are common innocent causes.
